design_principle: claim-backward, nested and outcome-blind sampling: define the maximum admissible claim first, then collect the smallest sample set that can discriminate that claim while banking inexpensive material for later gated analyses

source_boundaries.phase_a_source_role: the pinned EAzami Phase A plan supplies prior minimum/recommended population counts; this design removes samples that do not map to current P01-P05 or M01 claims and stages expensive assays behind evidence gates

core_breadth_panel.purpose: discriminate P01-P04 histories with own same-library ancestry while reusing the same individuals for P05 calibrated morphology wherever possible

all_japan_floor.allocation_rule: use independently collected wild individuals; where feasible split 2+1 across two populations rather than three plants from one patch; do not replace a blocked concept after inspecting topology leverage
all_japan_floor.claim_supported: P03 all-Japan topology/network sensitivity and P04 cross-module same-individual history
all_japan_floor.claim_not_supported: population-genomic selection, definitive species tree or adaptation

focal_oversampling.reason: terminal-versus-internal phyllary placement must survive within-species population ancestry rather than one local accession
the JPN06-JPN15 contrast must be separated from local population structure or introgression
the JPN06-JPN15 contrast must be separated from local population structure or introgression

derived_totals.calculation: 114 all-Japan floor plus focal top-ups for JPN36, JPN06 and JPN15; P04 reuses these individuals and P05 initially reuses their calibrated images rather than adding fresh field samples

core_breadth_panel.p04_measurement_rule: orientation, phyllary posture, stickiness, voucher/diagnostic images, population and cytotype status are recorded before DNA results are inspected on every core individual where the state is observable
core_breadth_panel.p05_rule: no additional fresh-collection quota is opened in v1; obtain calibrated capitulum images from the core individuals first, then supplement with rights-cleared voucher/herbarium images under a separately frozen taxon-balanced measurement design if direct-measurement coverage remains inadequate
core_breadth_panel.technical_replication: library/process duplicates are 5-10 percent of libraries, selected before outcome inspection; they are technical replicates and do not count toward biological n

m01_depth_panel.principle: do not collect the full E3 panel before E1/E2 are scientifically viable; bank cheap leaf/photo material early, but stage RNA and population-genomic sequencing behind explicit gates

stage_m1_history_and_expression_discover.goal: reach at most E1-E2 without confounding species with a single locality

focal_population_roles.role_2: one independently authorized Amami-group population, preferably Amami Oshima when feasible
one core Yaeyama population, preferably Ishigaki or Iriomote depending authorization and RNA logistics

mandatory_for_all: silica or equivalent leaf DNA material
per_population_field_bank.reserve_rule: reserve identities are fixed before laboratory QC and may replace only technical failures, never weak or inconvenient biological outcomes

rna_subset.rule: same-individual pigment and RNA material, identical floral developmental stage and matched collection window; a second developmental stage is optional follow-up, not required for the first E2 contrast

pigment_subset.rule: quantify homologous pigment chemistry on individuals nested inside the photographed/DNA panel; do not infer anthocyanin identity from RGB colour alone

ancestral_state_outgroup_panel.target_structure: at least four Nipponocirsium concepts because Arenicola is sister to Nipponocirsium, plus at least two Sinocirsium concepts as the next bracketing lineage
ancestral_state_outgroup_panel.polymorphism_rule: if a concept is colour-polymorphic, represent at least three individuals per observed colour state rather than collapsing the concept to one state
ancestral_state_outgroup_panel.acquisition_rule: fresh/cultivated collaborator material with documented identity and rights is acceptable for chemistry; the user does not need to field-collect all outgroups personally

stage_m1_history_and_expression_discover.promotion_gate: do not open E3 sequencing unless ancestral-state/pigment comparison is interpretable and the E2 expression association replicates across the two populations within each focal lineage

stage_m2_population_genomic_selection.goal: reach at most E3 selection-consistent evidence

Cirsium brevicaule: one southern Amami-group population such as Okinoerabu or Yoron when verified

stage_m2_population_genomic_selection.pilot_status: 12 individuals per population may be used for a structure/QC pilot but is not the final E3 panel
stage_m2_population_genomic_selection.sampling_geometry: avoid obvious close relatives and collect across the occupied patch; exact spacing is site-specific and frozen before collection, not tuned after genotypes are seen
stage_m2_population_genomic_selection.sequencing_platform_gate: do not lock a cross-lineage selection platform before E2 candidate nomination and reference/orthology qualification; preferred E3 routes are lineage-aware resequencing against qualified references or a validated capture/resequencing design, whereas RAD-only cross-species FST is not sufficient
stage_m2_population_genomic_selection.demography_gate: fit neutral within-lineage population structure/demographic background before interpreting phenotype-linked candidate regions
stage_m2_population_genomic_selection.no_agent_claim: even a successful E3 result does not identify butterflies, flies, climate or another selective agent

field_burden_control.distributed_collection_allowed: authorized collaborators may collect under the same protocol; individual identity, voucher/diagnostic images, population IDs and authorization IDs must be retained
field_burden_control.personal_priority: if investigator field time is limited, personally secure the four M01 discovery populations and the hardest core focal populations; use collaborator acquisition for the remaining all-Japan breadth concepts and terminal island endpoints
field_burden_control.no_required_manipulation: M01 E0-E3 requires no bagging, artificial-flower experiment, single-visit pollination assay or long camera deployment

assay_staging.action: collect nothing until taxon, population, permissions and immutable IDs are frozen
sequence the 114-individual all-Japan floor plus outcome-blind focal top-ups needed for P01/P02
run ancestral-state and pigment-chemistry discrimination using the four focal discovery populations plus bracketing outgroup concepts
sequence 20 primary corolla RNA libraries only if G2 remains interpretable; validate across two populations per lineage
expand/sequence the 4-population-per-lineage 120-individual population-genomic panel only if E2 produces a replicable candidate mechanism and orthology/reference QC passes

stop_rules: do not replace inaccessible taxa or populations after observing their expected topology or candidate-gene leverage
do not promote three individuals per concept into a population-genomic claim
do not spend E3 sequencing budget when E1/E2 fails the predeclared promotion gate
do not use one population per species for RNA as evidence of a species-level expression mechanism
do not use taxon-level colour coding for a polymorphic concept when individual states are available
do not treat technical reserve replacement as biological resampling
do not use M01 population genomics to identify a selective agent
